_comment: Porting notes written by humans/agents, merged into each screen's spec by design-specs.cjs and the pema-design MCP. groups.<group code> applies to every screen in the group; screens.<screen code> to that screen only. Keys: logic, rules, differences, gotchas, todo (string arrays). Write in English; keep Vietnamese UI text and business wording verbatim in quotes. Quick add: MCP tool record_note, or edit this file then run node .claude/skills/pema-canvas-to-kmp-compose/scripts/design-specs.cjs.

logic: `WorkspaceScreen` (`feature/workspace/WorkspaceGraph.kt`) › owner body per tab; shell `App.kt` (NavHost, route guard, `PaymentAlerts`).
rules: The clinic owner has 5 tabs: "Hôm nay" / "Lịch hẹn" / "Hồ sơ" / "Theo dõi" / "Thêm". The bottom nav belongs to Workspace, not a global nav.
differences: Real Pema logo instead of the canvas "pema" text.
Real sample data (46 records) instead of illustrative names.
gotchas: The selected tab must be `rememberSaveable`: NavHost drops `remember` when pushing a child route, so coming back would reset to tab 0.

The Workspace body is one `LazyColumn` for every tab/role (`ownerItems`/`staffItems`/`careItems` in WorkspaceGraph.kt): add blocks as `item { … }` and tiles with the `tile(...)` helper, never a scrolling `Column` + `forEach` (all rows were composed on each tab switch: ~2 s on a Redmi Note 9 debug build). The `LazyListState` is saved per tab (`rememberSaveable(role, tab)`), so each tab opens at its top and keeps its position after a pushed route.

logic: `WorkspaceScreen` › staff body (doctor).
rules: Doctors have 2 tabs ("Công việc", "Hồ sơ mẫu") and only see records they own (`Session.owns`).

logic: CareQueue (`feature/care/CareQueue.kt`, state `shared/care/CareQueue.kt`) embedded in Workspace.
rules: 3 states: "Chưa liên hệ" / "Đã liên hệ" / "Chờ bác sĩ"; 10 CSKH groups filtered in a bottom sheet.
gotchas: `rememberSaveable` of `CareQueueFilter` (data class) needs a `listSaver`, otherwise Android crashes when navigating.

logic: `WorkspaceScreen` › staff body (accountant).
rules: Accountants have 2 tabs; allowed routes: "Thu ngân", "Hóa đơn", "Hướng dẫn" (+ web: "Thu ngân · hóa đơn", "Dịch vụ & tài chính", "Lịch sử hợp nhất", "Hồ sơ mới").

logic: `WorkspaceScreen` › care body (care mode).
rules: Patients have 4 tabs: "Trang chủ" / "Hành trình" / "Tin nhắn" / "Hồ sơ"; only care routes are allowed (`Session.allows`).
gotchas: Stores live in `AppStores` per process: rotating the phone must not send the user back to Clinic.

logic: Detail routes registered by each feature graph in the `App.kt` NavHost; screens are pushed on top of Workspace.
gotchas: A snackbar shown after `back()` must use `rememberPemaMessenger()` (root scope), not the screen's `rememberCoroutineScope()`.

logic: Care-mode detail routes only (`Session.allows`).
`feature/finance` › FinanceScreen / RateScreen / ProcedureFormScreen; `FinanceStore` (polling).
rules: Calls the finance API `http://127.0.0.1:4174` (`python prototype/finance_server.py`, `adb reverse tcp:4174 tcp:4174`). API down → error screen + "Thử lại".

logic: Web-only: logic ported from `prototype/shared/*.js` into the `shared/clinic` domain (`ClinicStore`, `transact` commands, `ClinicError` errors keep the web's Vietnamese messages).
Permissions follow `prototype/shared/staff-context.js` (`pages` + `capabilities`) → `Session.allows` + `session.staffContext().can(...)`.
rules: Entry point: the "Vận hành phòng khám" item at the end of each role's main screen (filtered by permission).
differences: Web seed data (DAY = 2026-09-20, P001 Nguyễn Minh Linh) instead of the canvas's illustrative names/dates.

logic: Web `prototype/shared/clinic.js` › patient360() tabs (consult, plan, session, photos, finance, crm, history) and modalHtml(type) (note, plan-edit, message, edit, care); `care-finance.js`, `crm-ui.js`.
rules: Entry point: the "Patient 360 đầy đủ" item in F1, filtered by role.
Clinical actions need the `clinical` capability (owner/doctor); other roles see "Cần tài khoản bác sĩ để thực hiện." / hidden buttons, like `staff-context.js apply()`.
differences: Web seed data instead of illustrative names/dates.

logic: Web `prototype/patient-mobile` + `prototype/shared/patient.js`.
differences: Web seed data instead of illustrative names/dates.

rules: Static WeekStrip: tapping a day does nothing — intended.

logic: Embeds PatientSearch from feature:patients (dependency exception) as lazy items: `rememberPatientSearchState(deps)` (saved query + rows filtered in `remember`) and `LazyListScope.patientSearchItems(state, onOpen)` (search field, then one `PemaTile` per profile keyed by its code). Same API for the staff "Hồ sơ mẫu" tab (B2, C5, D2).
gotchas: The owner sees all 46 profiles: keep the list lazy (only the ~7 on-screen tiles are composed). Measured on the emulator (debug build), first open went from 728 ms to 269 ms per tab switch; screenshots stayed pixel-identical.
Don't nest `verticalScroll` inside `PemaBottomSheet`/`ModalBottomSheet` (crash); the scroll layer is in the overlay.

logic: `PaymentAlerts` wraps the whole app (feature:finance): SnackBar when the unread payment count increases, even on child screens; "Xem" opens Finance on the notifications tab (3).

rules: Contact notes are internal and never shown to the patient.
logic: Link "Ghi nhận CSKH đầy đủ" → I13 (optional callback, hidden by default so the C6 shot stays the same).
The "Patient 360 đầy đủ" items (J1–J11) are added at the end, filtered by `Session.allows`.
Shows photos sent by the patient (`PatientState.photos`) with `LocalPhoto`.
The clinic owner also sees "Chỉnh dịch vụ" → I9 `service-edit?id=S<index>` (optional callback).
The clinic owner also sees the "Khóa thời gian phòng" button → I8 (optional callback).

rules: Unknown routes open GuideScreen(route) (fallback of `resolveRoute`).
Permission-blocked screen (`_RouteGuard`): "Tác vụ không thuộc không gian hiện tại. Quay lại để chọn đúng công việc."; KMP `DeniedScreen` in composeApp, route `Routes.denied(title)`.
With a photo, "Tôi đồng ý chia sẻ ảnh để chăm sóc" must be ticked before sending.
logic: Camera: `deps.platform.camera.capture()` (system camera app, no CAMERA permission), photo 1600px JPEG 85 with EXIF/GPS stripped in `cache/photos`.
gotchas: The draft uses `rememberSaveable(saver = SendUpdateDraft.Saver)`; collect `camera.recoveredPhotos()` to receive photos when Android recreates the activity; delete unsent photos with `OnScreenCleared`, not `DisposableEffect`.

Tested on a Xiaomi M2003J15SC (Android 12/MIUI): when the process is killed while the camera is open, the photo and text are still recovered. The workspace (Session) is saved with the back stack (`RestoreSessionAfterProcessDeath` in App.kt), so the restored G2 still belongs to Pema Care.
A successful send calls `camera.markSaved(path)` (in `SendUpdateDraft.submit`): the photo stops being a draft and is deleted on the next process start.

logic: "Trước" = first photo (when there are ≥ 2 photos), "Gần nhất" = last photo, from `PatientState.photos`.

rules: Error state when the finance API is down, with a "Thử lại" button.

logic: Web `crm-ui.js` › dashboard(): operations + CSKH KPIs (crmQueue).
rules: "Ưu tiên chăm sóc" rows: select the record (`sessionStore.select`) then open I13.

logic: Web `crm-ui.js` › today(); commands `ClinicStore.reception(id, status)` / `setStatus`.
gotchas: Only filter by doctor when the role is doctor (web `Staff.owns`); the owner sees all 31 appointments.
The "Đặt lịch mới" FAB must be in DetailScaffold's `floatingActionButton` slot (already padded for the navigation bar).

logic: Web `operations-ui.js` › schedule(): schedule per room, preparation buffer, waitlist, room blocks.
differences: Unlike A2, this WeekStrip can pick a day (7 days seeded from DAY, weekday labels computed from real dates).
rules: Tapping an appointment → I4 reschedule `appointment-form?id=<id>`.

logic: Web `operations-ui.js` › booking dialog; `ClinicStore.validate` / `saveAppointment` (the web's error messages).
rules: Route parameters: `appointment-form?id={id}&patient={patient}&crmTask={crmTask}`; with crmTask, the CSKH task is marked as booked when saving succeeds.
Doctor role: the doctor is fixed to the signed-in doctor.

logic: Web `clinic.js` › patients() › "Hồ sơ mới"; the `createPatient` command (ClinicToolsCommands) also syncs `MutableCatalogRepository` so the new record appears in search.
Web `clinic.js` › followups(): filters "Ảnh" / "Triệu chứng" / "Quá hạn"; doctors only see their own records (`owns`).
rules: Tapping an item → select the record then open F10 "Phản hồi".

logic: Web `clinic.js` › studio() + photos(p): real photos = treatment sessions with an `image` for the same view; first = "Trước", last = "Sau"; none → illustrative images.
rules: "Thêm ảnh" like web `capture`: opens J5 "Ghi buổi điều trị" (photo attached to a session + photo consent).
"So sánh trượt" only when there are 2 different photos.

Slider comparison as on the web: the "Sau" photo is the background, the "Trước" photo covers the left part up to the slider position (`clip-path: inset(0 (100-v)% 0 0)`), label "Trước ← → Sau" at the top; "Trước"/"Sau" dates in the two bottom corners.
gotchas: Tested on a real phone: the first version was reversed ("Sau" on the left). The canvas doesn't draw slider mode, so follow the web.

logic: Web `operations-ui.js` › resources() save-block; `ClinicStore.block` (08:00–18:00, reason required, must not clash with appointments).
Web `operations-ui.js` › services() dialog 'service'; `ClinicStore.updateService` (15–180 minutes, buffer 0–60, price ≥ 0).
rules: Route `service-edit?id={id}`, default S2.

logic: Web `operations-ui.js` › cashier(): every invoice in the clinic, filters "Còn phải thu" / "Đã thanh toán".
Web `operations-ui.js` › action 'pay' dialog; `ClinicStore.pay` (never above the balance, "Tiền mặt"/"Chuyển khoản").
gotchas: The shot uses a static overlay like F12 (`previewPaymentSheet`).

logic: Web `clinic.js` › ask(): suggested questions + free query, answers include "Cách tính" and sources.
Web `crm-ui.js` "Xử lý" form; `ClinicStore.resolveCrmTask` / `prepareCrmBooking` (CashierCrmCommands).
rules: The outcome "Đồng ý đặt lịch" opens I4 with `crmTask` before completing.
No real Zalo/SMS or calls.

logic: Web consult tab + actions generate-note / approve-note; `generateConsultDraft`, `approveConsultDraft`, `saveClinicalNote`.
rules: AI only creates a draft; the doctor edits and approves it before saving.

logic: Web modal 'note' + `Pema.brief(p)` → `brief(state, patient)`; approve-brief → `approveAiBrief`.
Web plan tab.
gotchas: Title clashes with the existing "Kế hoạch điều trị" route: route `Routes.PlanOverview` has the unique key "Kế hoạch điều trị · Clinic", the app bar title comes from `Routes.appBarTitleOf`.

logic: Web modal 'plan-edit' + save-plan; `updateTreatmentPlan` (total ≥ sessions done, ≤ 20).
Web session tab + save-session; `recordTreatmentSession` (TreatmentSessionInput.photoPath = landmark photo).
rules: A landmark photo requires photo consent; saving without a photo creates the follow-up "Thiếu ảnh mốc đánh giá".
Landmark photo: sheet "Chụp ảnh / Chọn ảnh có sẵn" (`PemaPhotoSourceSheet`), preview + "Chụp lại" / "Chọn ảnh khác" / "Bỏ ảnh".
gotchas: Unsaved photos are deleted by `OnScreenCleared` when the screen closes; saved photos belong to the treatment session.
The photo consent box defaults to `patient.photoConsent` (P001 is pre-ticked) — tapping it unticks it; not a touch bug.
Saving a session with a photo calls `camera.markSaved(path)` before clearing `pending.path`.

logic: Web finance tab + `care-finance.js`; `careFinanceSummary(patientId)`.
rules: Never infer completed treatment from payment.
"Mở thu ngân" only with the billing capability.

logic: Web `crm-ui.js` patient CRM panel; "Sửa ngày dự kiến" → `setExpectedVisit`.
Web history tab: merged events, newest first, with recorder and source.
Web modal 'message'.
rules: Messages appear in the patient's "Tin nhắn" tab (E3); not an emergency channel; hidden from CSKH/accountants.

logic: Web modal 'edit' + save-facts (one alert per line, photo consent).
Web modal 'care' + save-care.
rules: Only approved instructions appear in the patient's "Chăm sóc tại nhà".

logic: Web `patient.js` › appointments(); `confirmPatientAttendance`.
rules: Entry point: the "Lịch hẹn tiếp theo" tile on the Care home.

logic: Web `patient.js` › docs(); approved items only, read-only.
rules: Entry point: Care "Hồ sơ" tab → "Tài liệu & hóa đơn".

logic: Web `patient.js` › journey(); `patientJourneyTimeline(patient)`.
differences: Merged into the "Hành trình" tab (E2): keeps E2's 4 items and adds the "Cập nhật gần đây" timeline + the sentence "tiến độ số buổi, không phải mức cải thiện da".
